title: Better than Adventure! - Italian language pack
description: An Italian language pack for the mod Better than Adventure!
body:
# About
An Italian language pack (translation) add-on for the beta 1.7.3 mod **[Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/)** release **7.3_04** and **8.0-pre2**

# Install
Place the "**it_IT.zip**" zip file into your BTA! languages folder. 
> multimc/instances/Better than Adventure- 7.3/.minecraft/languages/

You can easily access it by going into the language packs menu in-game and then open the folder from there. Once installed, refresh the language packs menu page and select it.
